SHIPPED: ADHD formally confirmed after testing on March 19, 2026. Psychiatrist said 'grey zone' but confirmed.
SIGNIFICANCE: Ends months of uncertainty. Diagnosis matches lived experience — modafinil response, bedsheet task saga, job-boredom-in-a-week pattern, murder mystery impatience, 'everything costs disproportionate effort.'
NEXT: Cardiologist clearance required before stimulant prescription (EKG/bloodwork safety check). Booked for Tuesday ~March 25. Then stimulants (Concerta likely) → eventual taper to bupropion for long-term maintenance.
PLAN: Stimulants as initial push to unlock reward system, then lighter maintenance. Ned is health-conscious — doesn't want stimulants forever.
MOM CONTEXT: Mom attended as collateral informant per psychiatrist requirement. Likely said 'he was always perfect and disciplined' — framed as high-masking rather than symptom absence.
